text: Prompt text, including PROMPT_VERSION, must live in src/adrcheck/chatmodel/prompts.py.
quote: The package `src/adrcheck/chatmodel/` holds the prompt text (`prompts.py`, including `PROMPT_VERSION`)

text: Reply parsers must live in src/adrcheck/chatmodel/parse.py.
ChatModelSeats must be defined in the chatmodel package and implement both ObligationCompiler and ChangeJudge over a single ChatRunner.
quote: `ChatModelSeats`, which implements both `ObligationCompiler` and `ChangeJudge` over one `ChatRunner`

text: A ChatRunner must turn one ChatRequest (system text plus user text) into one ChatReply (text and usage).
quote: A `ChatRunner` turns one `ChatRequest` (system text plus user text) into one `ChatReply` (text and usage).

text: Providers must be implemented as runners in src/adrcheck/adapters/, including ClaudeCliRunner over `claude -p` and AnthropicRunner over the Anthropic Messages API.
quote: Providers are runners in `src/adrcheck/adapters/`: `ClaudeCliRunner` over `claude -p` and `AnthropicRunner` over the Anthropic Messages API

text: Provider selection must go through a `provider:model` string handled in providers.py.
The chatmodel package must not import any adapter module.
quote: `chatmodel` imports no adapter, no SDK and no subprocess.

text: The chatmodel package must not import any provider SDK (e.g. anthropic).
quote: `chatmodel` imports no adapter, no SDK and no subprocess.

text: The chatmodel package must not import or use subprocess.
quote: `chatmodel` imports no adapter, no SDK and no subprocess.

text: When a runner raises, the judge must return an error response rather than letting the exception propagate through the use case.
quote: A runner that raises makes the judge return an error response; it never raises through the use case.

text: The compile prompt must remain byte-identical to the first adapter's so cached obligations under the current PROMPT_VERSION stay valid.
quote: The compile prompt stays byte-identical to the first adapter's, so cached obligations under the current `PROMPT_VERSION` remain valid.

text: Every provider must send the same prompt words; providers must not carry their own prompt variants.
quote: Every provider sends the same words, so the eval set compares models.

text: The system text of the judge request must be a cacheable block for providers that cache; claude -p concatenates it into one piece.
quote: The system text of the judge request is a cacheable block for providers that cache; `claude -p` concatenates it

text: The Anthropic runner's cost must be a list-price estimate from a table, and must be zero for an unknown model rather than guessed.
quote: Cost for the Anthropic runner is a list-price estimate from a table and is zero for an unknown model, which is reported as such rather than guessed.
